description: This file implements the backend logic for handling notification subscriptions in the focalboard server, including subscription management, event handling, and notification hint updates.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Struct managing notification subscriptions, event handling, and notification hints.

classes.name: BackendParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for initializing the Backend.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Backend instance with provided parameters.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the notification backend, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: ShutDown
methods.description: Stops the backend and flushes logs.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the backend.

methods.name: getBlockUpdateFreq
methods.description: Determines notification frequency based on environment variable or default settings.

methods.name: BlockChanged
methods.description: Handles block change events, manages subscriptions, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: notifySubscribers
methods.description: Creates or updates notification hints and triggers notifier for subscribers.

methods.name: OnMention
methods.description: Handles @mention events by subscribing mentioned users to relevant cards if permissions allow.
